cc:Work.dc:title: Ablation: tokens, estimated cost, and recorded latency
cc:Work.dc:description: Input is peak counted context, not cumulative provider usage. Token and cost means match between 2K and 4K. Latency includes OS/commit differences and is not a causal budget comparison. Costs are recorded LLM estimates, excluding CountTokens and infrastructure. Sources: docs/results/ablation_2k_h100_20261111/summary.json; docs/experiments/reports/ablation-2k-h100-2026-11-11.md; docs/experiments/reports/ablation-2k-h100-analysis-2026-11-11.md
